profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
I’m invigorated by defining the vision for products and my department as a whole. I’m curious, driven, and passionate about working with teams to create the next big thing.

Let's change the world.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Firmware Qual Automation Lead
• Designed and implemented a process to automate firmware qualification, achieving Minimum Viable Product (MVP) in approximately one month.
• Developed a system projected to save over $3 million annually by reducing manual testing efforts.
• Automated test plan generation, test scheduling, and results analysis across key quality gates.
• Provided automation support for ChromeOS and an Android-based device platform build and test flows.
• Scaled the automation solution to enable partners and support testing in distributed lab environments.
• Managed, architected, and designed a critical tool for automating code synchronization between repositories.

AMD Platform Bringup Lead
• Led firmware development and bringup efforts for new ChromeOS devices based on AMD platforms.
• Facilitated knowledge transfer sessions between Google and AMD to empower partners.
• Developed initial Application Processor (AP) Firmware images for multiple new platforms.
• Provided on-site support at a factory in Taiwan for first device power-on, achieving successful boot to Kernel within one week.

Firmware Toolchain Lead
• Managed and automated the generation and maintenance of firmware toolchains.
• Provided toolchain support for 5-10 code bases across the ChromeOS ecosystem.

Incident Response
• Participated in on-call rotations for ChromeOS and an Android-based device platform.
• Served as incident response lead for multiple high-severity incidents, coordinating efforts to mitigate impact and restore service.
• Routinely troubleshot build/test failures, infrastructure problems, and project configurations to maintain build stability and developer productivity.
• Mitigated security vulnerabilities identified in a new device platform during internal testing, unblocking device enrollment and team-wide testing.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked cybersecurity IRAD hardening bus flight software written in ada.
• Developed and integrated Payload Controller Electronics flight software written in C/C++ which managed/synchronized five other embedded systems to control a space vehicle instrument.
• Implemented automated tools to build and test flight software, embed metadata to identify the build environment and source, and perform static analysis
• Interviewed potential candidates
• Participated in ROMS and proposals
• Chief Engineer and Architect on multiple IRADs and product lines
• Technical lead on multiple IRADs and programs
• Participated as a member of a department initiative to define the technology roadmap and desirable capabilities for our product lines.
• Created, designed, and led a software academy to foster a more collaborative and growth focused environment within the software engineering department. Monthly lectures provide engineers opportunities to explore new topics, engage and interact with subject matter experts.
• Stepped in to design and lead R/F testing and PCB/FPGA analysis and development when a program I was the tech lead for was short staffed.

positions.title: ASIC Verification Engineer III
positions.description:
Responsible for construction and maintenance of simulation environments using System Verilog with UVM (Universal Verification Methodology). Derive test requirements and construct sequences for interfaces/hardware designs based on existing design documentation and requirements. Analyze RTL (VHDL and Verilog) to detect test failures and offer solutions.  Responsible for gate sims and power estimates of an ASIC design.  Responsible for qualitative analysis and signal integrity checks through a DSP.  Responsible for continuous integration environment, enabling automatic, regular testing of the ASIC design.

Performed in depth engineering analysis on units that didn't initially pass flight testing.  Analysis included signal probe, unique test procedure, x-ray, power strain analysis, thermal cycling hardware and performing functional analysis, EMI analysis of test equipment, SerDes performance and signal integrity testing and calibration.  Was able to disposition all units, and get all but one back on track and delivered to the customer.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description: Responsible for the vision and technical path, development, and integrations with partners of the ACORN product line.  Managed relationships with partners and led the engineering team through a product redesign and product relaunch.

positions.title: Linux System Administrator
positions.description: Installed and managed a Linux system which hosted engineering and build tools, a wiki, license servers, continuous integration systems and configuration management tools.

positions.title: Embedded Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed embedded and desktop software for use in real time spacecraft modeling and simulation.  Designed and developed hardware abstraction and hardware in the loop capability for the integrated simulation environment.

Co-designed initial concept of an FPGA-based hardware communications platform intended for use in protocol translation between different buses.

positions.title: ASIC Verification Engineer II
positions.description: Responsible for construction and maintenance of simulation environments using System Verilog with UVM (Universal Verification Methodology).  Derive test requirements and construct sequences for  interfaces/hardware designs based on existing design documentation and requirements.  Analyze RTL (VHDL and Verilog) to detect test failures and offer solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Design and develop software for both embedded systems and standalone PC applications to test and integrate formal flight hardware for spacecraft.  Software written in C/C++.  Design test scripts for formal testing of the unit prior to delivery in lua, shell scripts, and custom scripting languages.

Participated in environmental testing of devices under test(thermal, thermal-vacuum, vibration)

positions.title: Software Design Engineer II (Embedded Systems)
positions.description: Responsible for full software life cycle of embedded software projects for currency counters/sorters/validators. Met and corresponded with domestic and international customers to generate requirements, work through development, and support pre-production implementations. Traveled to domestic customers to assist with first time installations. Developed testing criteria for products and assisted with production. Designed a bootloader which works with multiple hardware configurations across the entire product line. Redesigned and reduced costs of a new product by 8% of the original cost by redesigning embedded code and eliminating hardware. Wrote hardware abstraction layers and redesigned embedded code running on multiple boards within the product line to upgrade to C/C++ from assembly and add additional features. Developed a product and collaborated with international partners to satisfy a request for information from the Federal Reserve.

positions.title: Laboratory Teaching Assistant ECE362 (Microprocessor Systems and Interfacing)
positions.description:
Provide brief lectures clarifying material and providing laboratory instructions.
Create and assign Final Projects involving assembly programs to simulate embedded systems.
Grade all relevant materials.

company.name: Purdue School of Engineering and Technology, IUPUI

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Redesigned and built an automated system to test manufactured parts as they came off of the
 production line. Project involved interfacing and controlling multiple instruments and meters through serial ports and a IEEE-488 bus. Application software was written in C# with a SQL database.

volunteerExperiences.description: Assisted in leading meetings and facilitated merit badge work, coordinating scouts to pursue their interests, development, and advancement within the organization, focusing on developing their leadership skills, sense of morality, and ambition.

publications.title: Self-Adapting Reconfigurable Co-Processor with Hardware Shadow Verification and Episodic Replay
Dynamic Reconfiguration Scheduling for Streaming Interconnects Using Queue-Depth Metrics
